$comment: MCP server registry for Claude and Codex. Disabled entries are operational tombstones: sync removes them from live configuration while preserving why they were rejected.
_exa_disabled: Exa MCP retired: dedicated paid search has no recurring need beyond native harness search. Sync removes existing Exa servers from Claude Code, Desktop, and Codex without requiring a credential. Revisit only for a concrete retrieval gap with measured value; optional Pi search-provider credentials remain machine-local, not distributed.
_granola_disabled: Granola MCP disabled 2026-09-05 — Granola has been retired, so its hosted MCP route and Codex plugin are no longer part of the Workbench connector set. (was: https://mcp.granola.ai/mcp, targets: claude/desktop/codex)
_context7_disabled: context7 MCP disabled 2026-06-09 — replaced by the `ctx7` CLI (`npx ctx7 library <name>` + `ctx7 docs <id>`, full 1:1 parity with the MCP's two tools). Docs lookup now needs no always-on MCP tax and is universal across every shell-capable agent, not patchy per-vendor. (was: https://mcp.context7.com/mcp, targets cursor/gemini)
_playwright_disabled: playwright MCP disabled 2026-06-09 — browser automation uses the Playwright framework for deterministic code and tests plus the native Agent Browser tool for agent-driven browsing. No always-on MCP context tax. (was: npx @playwright/mcp@latest, targets: claude/cursor/codex/gemini)
_linear_disabled: Linear MCP disabled 2026-05-07 — re-enable if needed (was: https://mcp.linear.app/mcp, targets: claude/cursor/codex)
_notion_disabled: Notion MCP disabled 2026-05-07 — re-enable if needed (was: https://mcp.notion.com/mcp, targets: claude/cursor/codex)
_datadog_disabled: Datadog MCP disabled 2026-05-07 — re-enable if needed (was: https://mcp.datadoghq.com/api/unstable/mcp-server/mcp, headers DD_API_KEY/DD_APPLICATION_KEY, targets: cursor)
_chrome-devtools_disabled: chrome-devtools MCP disabled 2026-05-07 — overlaps Playwright and Agent Browser diagnostics; launch ad hoc only for an unmet trace need (was: npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest, targets: claude/cursor/codex)
_neon_disabled: Neon MCP disabled 2026-04-09 — revisit when actively using Neon projects
